text:
The BBC claims that no team has ever got 11 points in the first 10 games and been relegated from the premiership.

If this is true then Hull City only need 3 points in 6 games and Ipswich 5 points in 6 games to be safe or they will be the first to go down with such a good start 🤔

As positive as that is for Hull and Ipswich who I think has surprised most, it obviously means that Palace, Spurs, Fulham, Villa and Coventry has a real cause for concern, especially given that Palace at home lost to Ipswich and Coventry at home lost to Hull. Its obviously too early to tell, but it is rare for momentum to shift too drastically in a league. Even when Leicester had a brilliant start and so many thought they would drop off eventually, they ended up winning the league.
